title: Turn a script into an explainer video

scenes.say: Hi, I'm Bit. Today I'll show you how to turn a script into an explainer video.
You write a short script. Each scene has the words I say, a slide, and how I feel about it.

slide.title: A scene is simple
items: My mood: neutral, happy, thinking or pointing

scenes.say: Then you run one command. The voice is generated locally, so nothing leaves your machine.
Captions are timed to the narration, and my mouth follows the voice. Not bad for a little robot.
There are three slide types: a title card, a list that reveals one item at a time, and a big highlight for the key idea. Mix them to tell your story.
Want a different voice? The speech engine is swappable. Kokoro runs offline, and Azure Speech is optional.

slide.title: Swap the voice
items: Azure Speech: optional, via environment variables

scenes.say: That's it. Write the script, run the command, and share your video.
